info.title: Lost Crypto API
info.description: Backend da plataforma Lost Crypto: dados de mercado, estratégias, backtests e paper trading.

get.description: Readiness: the process is up and the database is reachable.
Liveness: the process is running (no dependencies checked).

post.description: Sign in. Returns the access token and sets the refresh-token cookie.
Trade the refresh cookie for a new access token (the cookie is rotated).
End this login: revokes the refresh token and clears the cookie.

get.description: The signed-in user (the frontend uses this to know the role).

post.description: Change your password; every session (including this one) is signed out.

schema.title: Response List Users Api V1 Auth Users Get

post.description: Create a user (admin only). Give a collaborator `viewer` for read-only access.
Disable a user and sign them out everywhere. You cannot disable yourself.

get.description: Available strategy types and their configurable parameters.

schema.title: Response List Strategies Api V1 Strategies Get

post.description: Queue a historical candle import. The worker runs it; poll the job for progress.

schema.title: Response List Imports Api V1 Market Data Imports Get

get.description: Stored candles with ``start <= open_time < end`` (at most ``limit``, oldest first).

schema.title: Response Get Candles Api V1 Market Data Candles Get

get.description: What is stored for a series, including detected gaps.

post.description:
Queue a backtest. The worker executes it; poll ``GET /backtests/{id}`` for the result.

Results are simulations on historical data, not a forecast of future returns.

get.description: Newest first; the size of the whole list is in ``X-Total-Count``.

schema.title: Response List Backtests Api V1 Backtests Get

post.description:
Queue one backtest per parameter combination of ``grid`` and compare them.

Combinations the strategy rejects (e.g. fast >= slow) are skipped and reported. With
``test_fraction`` set, rank by the test (out-of-sample) return to avoid picking an overfit
parameter set.

get.description: Several backtests side by side, in the order requested.

schema.title: Response Compare Backtests Api V1 Backtests Compare Get

get.description: Simulated fills (buys and sells) in chronological order.

schema.title: Response Get Trades Api V1 Backtests  Run Id  Trades Get

get.description: Equity curve marked at every candle close (empty until the run completes).

schema.title: Response Get Equity Api V1 Backtests  Run Id  Equity Get

post.description: Create a paper-trading bot. It starts stopped; call ``/start`` to run it.

schema.title: Response List Bots Api V1 Bots Get

get.description: Equity, PnL and fees added up per execution mode and quote currency (never mixed).

schema.title: Response Get Summary Api V1 Bots Summary Get

get.description: Every bot with its current equity and return, for side-by-side comparison.

schema.title: Response Get Overview Api V1 Bots Overview Get

patch.description: Change the configuration of a stopped bot (creates a new config version).

post.description:
Ask the worker to run the bot (or resume it). Poll the bot for ``observed_state``.

A **live** bot needs `confirmation_token` every time it starts (see live-approvals).

get.description: The checklist a bot must pass before it may trade real money (all items must be ok).

post.description:
Point a stopped bot at a live connection. This does NOT start trading: it still needs
the readiness checklist and a one-time approval.

Step 1 of starting a live bot: pass the checklist and type its name. Returns a token that
is single-use, short-lived and valid only for the bot's current configuration.
Stop evaluating the strategy; the session and its state are kept.
End the session. The virtual portfolio (including any open position) is kept.
Restart the virtual portfolio from the initial capital (stopped bots only).

schema.title: Response Get Orders Api V1 Bots  Bot Id  Orders Get

get.description: Strategy signals and what the risk layer decided (approved / rejected / discarded_stale).

schema.title: Response Get Signals Api V1 Bots  Bot Id  Signals Get

get.description: Performance metrics net of fees (null until the bot has produced a snapshot).

schema.title: Response Get Performance Api V1 Bots  Bot Id  Performance Get
Response Get Equity Api V1 Bots  Bot Id  Equity Get

put.description:
Emergency stop. While active, the worker pauses every running bot and no new entries
are approved. Releasing it does not resume bots: start them again explicitly.

get.description: Is live trading possible here, and if not, what is missing? Contains no secrets.
Is the worker alive and is every running bot advancing? Poll this from a monitor.

Append-only trail of commands, state changes, orders and risk events (newest first).
The size of the whole trail that matches is in ``X-Total-Count``.

schema.title: Response List Audit Events Api V1 Audit Events Get

get.description:
Failure alerts, newest first. An alert stays until it is resolved and read; the size of
the whole list that matches is in ``X-Total-Count``.

schema.title: Response List Alerts Api V1 Alerts Get

get.description: Unread alerts and the alerts still open (without resolution), for the header indicator.

schema.title: Response List Connections Api V1 Exchange Connections Get

post.description:
Register exchange credentials. They are stored encrypted, only the worker can decrypt
them, and they are never returned. **Live** keys start `pending`: the worker checks what
they may do and refuses any key that can withdraw or transfer funds.
Stop using these credentials. Bots bound to a disabled connection cannot start.

confirm_name.title: Confirm Name
confirm_name.description: Type the bot's exact name to confirm you mean it

confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token
confirmation_token.description: Shown once. Valid for one start of this version

fee_rate.title: Fee Rate
fee_rate.description: Fraction of notional (0.001 = 0.1%). Defaults to the exchange's taker fee.

slippage_bps.title: Slippage Bps
slippage_bps.description: Adverse slippage per fill, in bps

test_fraction.title: Test Fraction
test_fraction.description: Hold out this share of the series (at the end) as an out-of-sample test part. Train and test metrics are then reported separately in `segments`.

fee_rate.title: Fee Rate
fee_rate.description: Defaults to the exchange's taker fee

connection_id.title: Connection Id
connection_id.description: Required for testnet bots: the exchange connection to use

BotUpdate.title: BotUpdate
BotUpdate.description: Every field optional. Only allowed while the bot is stopped.

CapabilitiesOut.title: CapabilitiesOut
CapabilitiesOut.description:
What this deployment allows, so the UI can explain instead of letting a user try and fail.
It reflects the API process's configuration; the worker enforces its own on every pass.

confirm_real_money.title: Confirm Real Money
confirm_real_money.description: Required for environment=live: these keys can spend REAL money

ConnectionOut.title: ConnectionOut
ConnectionOut.description: What the API ever returns about a connection: no secret, only a hint of the key.

end.title: End
end.description: Exclusive. Candles still in progress are skipped

JobStatus.title: JobStatus
JobStatus.description: Lifecycle shared by the DB-backed jobs the worker executes.

connection_id.title: Connection Id
connection_id.description: An ACTIVE live connection of the bot's exchange

confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token
confirmation_token.description: Live bots only: the single-use token from POST /bots/{id}/live-approvals

fee_rate.title: Fee Rate
fee_rate.description: Fraction of notional (0.001 = 0.1%). Defaults to the exchange's taker fee.

slippage_bps.title: Slippage Bps
slippage_bps.description: Adverse slippage per fill, in bps

test_fraction.title: Test Fraction
test_fraction.description: Hold out this share of the series (at the end) as an out-of-sample test part. Train and test metrics are then reported separately in `segments`.

grid.title: Grid
grid.description: Parameter name -> values to try. One run per combination (max 200).

TokenOut.title: TokenOut
TokenOut.description:
Keep ``access_token`` in memory and send it as ``Authorization: Bearer``. The refresh
token travels only in an httpOnly cookie, out of reach of page scripts.

can_write.title: Can Write
can_write.description: May this user change anything? The server enforces it; the UI only reflects it.
